construction.how_draws_are_read: draw j of matched_twins.twin_series_sticky is re-run alone (n_draws=1) under matched_twins._draw_id(rule, j), whose draw-0 seed equals seed_for(rule, j); draws never interact, so every partner, weight and trade is v1's. The aggregate (mean over draws of twin gross / cost / turnover / full_rt; counts summed) is the v1 21-draw frame (pinned by backend/tests/test_sticky_twin_v2.py).
construction.name: TWIN_STICKY_v1 (UNCHANGED)

licence: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT (a control construction check for historical boards; no book, no order, $0 LLM)
reads: headline: rules at sticky fair-twin t >= 2 under v2; of those, pure selection t >= 2; of those, net-minus-market t >= 2 in validation; by_year and leave-one-year-out for any positive. Per rule: v1 vs v2 gap and verdict change.

receipt_check.name: TWIN_STICKY_CHECK_v2_per_draw
receipt_check.rule: for each draw j and each invested month m: if draw j had a died or collision redraw in month m, the pair (j, m) is excluded (for that draw only); otherwise gap(j, m) = |draw j's twin one-way turnover - rule one-way turnover|. The row's gap is the MEDIAN over all retained (draw, month) pairs. median <= tolerance -> OK; else the board row is REFUSED with the gap. No retained pair -> REFUSED.
receipt_check.tolerance_note: unchanged from TWIN_STICKY_v1 and config.STICKY_TWIN_TURNOVER_TOLERANCE; not re-tuned
receipt_check.v1_beside: the v1 month-level check is computed on the aggregate frame and printed beside every row (sticky_turnover_check_v1); it does not refuse under v2

run.memory: refuses below 4 GB free (hyp_twin_board waits up to 60 min)
run.rules: all 301 RUN rules of the three CRSP library runs (scripts.hyp_twin_board RUNS)

status: a CHECK version, not a new twin. TRIAL-LIB-FWD-TWIN-1 and CRSP_BLEND_v0 are untouched; the registered matched_twins.twin_series is untouched.
what_was_seen_before_this_declaration: The v1 sticky board STK_2026-10-07_2 (277 OK, 24 refused by the v1 check at medians 0.0305-0.0777; 44 at fair t >= 2; 40 with selection t >= 2; 1 (qc761) with validation market t >= 2), its supplement STK_2026-10-07_3, and the note's statement that the median rule had 83% of its months excluded under v1. No per-draw gap was computed for any rule before this declaration. Changing the check after the v1 run is a check chosen after seeing a result; the tolerance and refusal rule are therefore carried over unchanged and the construction is byte-identical.
